title.zh: ECB deploys Pontes platform to settle wholesale tokenized assets in central-bank money
title.en: ECB deploys Pontes platform to settle wholesale tokenized assets in central-bank money

current_state.zh: 欧元体系已推出 Pontes，为银行提供以中央银行货币结算代币化资产的实时通道；欧洲央行同时准备将自有资金投资于通过 Pontes 结算的代币化证券，全面实施目标为 2028 年。
current_state.en: The Eurosystem has launched Pontes, giving banks a live route to settle tokenized assets in central-bank money, while the ECB is preparing to invest its own funds in tokenized securities settling through Pontes, with full implementation targeted for 2028.

updates.title_zh: 欧洲央行推出“面向银行的数字欧元”，并准备购买代币化债券
updates.title_en: ECB launches ‘digital euro for banks’ and prepares to buy tokenized bonds
updates.what_changed_zh: 欧洲央行开始准备将一小部分自有资金投资于通过 Pontes 结算的代币化证券，并披露了首批参与机构及 2028 年全面实施目标。
updates.what_changed_en: The ECB began preparations to invest a small portion of its own funds in tokenized securities settling through Pontes, and disclosed initial participants and a full implementation target of 2028.
updates.current_state_zh: 欧元体系已推出 Pontes，为银行提供以中央银行货币结算代币化资产的实时通道；欧洲央行同时准备将自有资金投资于通过 Pontes 结算的代币化证券，全面实施目标为 2028 年。
updates.current_state_en: The Eurosystem has launched Pontes, giving banks a live route to settle tokenized assets in central-bank money, while the ECB is preparing to invest its own funds in tokenized securities settling through Pontes, with full implementation targeted for 2028.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: 欧元体系周一推出 Pontes，为银行提供以中央银行货币结算代币化资产的实时通道；欧洲央行同时开始准备将一小部分自有资金投资于代币化证券，并通过 Pontes 结算。欧洲央行自有资金在2025年底价值231亿欧元，其中政府债务占73%，但该央行尚未披露代币化配置规模或购买启动时间。
updates.detailed_summary_en: The Eurosystem launched Pontes on Monday, giving banks a live route to settle tokenized assets in central-bank money, while the ECB began preparations to invest a small portion of its own funds in tokenized securities settling through Pontes. The ECB’s own-funds holdings were worth €23.1 billion at the end of 2025, with government debt at 73%, but it has not disclosed the size of the tokenized allocation or when purchases will begin.
